newsitem.title: USA: MasTec buys Harrison-Wright Co Inc.
newsitem.headline: MasTec buys Harrison-Wright Co Inc.

text.p: Mastec Inc said it had acquired "substantially all" the assets of Harrison-Wright Co Inc, a telecommunications contractor with operations mainly in Georgia and in the Carolinas.
It did not diclose the terms of the deal.
MasTec also said it was postponing indefinitely its previously announced public offering of common stock for cash.
It said the offering was no longer necessary to pursue MasTec's acquisition strategy because of the increase in value of MasTec common stock registered earlier in a shelf registration.

Stronger than expected operating performance and cash flows should provide sufficient funds to satisfy the company's cash flow requirements for the foreseeable future without the necessity of raising additional equity capital, it added.
MasTec is a telecommunications and related infrastructure service provider.
